hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GiB, CUDA 11.8, Vulkan
notes: GGML strict and Vulkan timings use NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 or Vulkan FP32-disable flags.

GGML CUDA fast uses TF32 Tensor Cores; strict and Vulkan retain FP32 arithmetic. Vulkan timing remains the validated portable fallback measurement.
PyTorch and GGML output images are generated from the same t4.png input.
